node.title: Re: Recover a path from a config file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Chaoui05],

Because the $folder variable is declared with [doc://my], it exists only for the scope of the config file and is not accessible from the main script. One quick solution would be to replace the "my" with an "[doc://our]" in the config file, as that declares the variable as a package ("global") variable, then add a declaration of "our $folder;" (or "use vars qw/$folder/;", but that's discouraged) before the line with do 'work.conf' (this is to satisfy [doc://strict]), then the variable $folder will be accessible in the script, and then you can do:

use File::Spec::Functions qw/catfile/; my $filename = catfile($folder, $config->{license});

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D

Edit: Minor updates to wording.
